leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a user signup endpoint that validates and stores new user data
Implement a login endpoint that authenticates users with email and password
Configure password hashing to securely store user credentials
Integrate validation middleware to check request data formats
Initialize a user data structure to persist registration information
Apply error handling to manage duplicate registrations and invalid logins
Manipulate response objects to return appropriate status codes and messages
